name: floor-storyfileshash-authoritative
title: Make the review-assurance-floor fresh-round count storyFilesHash-authoritative so unrelated main merges stop forcing a full quorum re-bind
description: Last-mile of the storyFilesHash work (B-5a9a/B-edf1). B-5a9a added a secondary storyFilesHash to verdict/evidence records and the evidence-freshness path already downgrade-accepts a stale-whole-tree-materialHash binding when storyFilesHash matches (valid-with-advisory). But the strict review-assurance FLOOR (review-assurance-floor.ts: evaluateHostVerdictRounds) still counts fresh local PASS rounds purely by whole-tree materialHash (currentMaterialHash), so when an unrelated main merge drifts the whole-tree hash, a story's just-submitted quorum host-verdicts are ignored as materialDigest-stale and the floor finds 0 fresh rounds, forcing a full re-bind (re-run all review lanes + re-submit quorum) during a main-quiet window. Two real stories (B-f248, B-7036) burned hours on this race on 2026-06-23. Fix: make the floor's fresh-round counting honor storyFilesHash exactly as the evidence path does (a verdict whose materialHash is stale but whose stored storyFilesHash matches the current story-owned-file state counts as a valid local round, valid-with-advisory, surfacing the re-attestation advisory), and exclude truly-stale verdicts from the per-round duplicate-host-identity check so accumulated prior-submit verdicts cannot poison a round. A real story-file change (storyFilesHash differs) must still correctly stale the rounds (the guard is not gamed).
